label: Flash Message
description: Displays a ThunderPHP flash message and can erase it after rendering.

properties.name: erase
properties.label: Erase after display
properties.help: Checks for the message without erasing it, then erases it only when the message is rendered.

properties.name: inline_style

properties.help: CSS declarations applied directly to the same element as the custom CSS classes.

properties.name: widths
